## Human-supervised AI-assisted research

AI assistants supported mathematical discussion, implementation and scientific
writing under human supervision. Gurobot supported formulation discussions;
Gemini and GPT systems supported technical criticism; ChatGPT Classic supported
coordination; and Codex supported Python development, tests and documentation.
Researchers selected assumptions and experimental configurations, reviewed
changes, executed the HPC commands and interpreted the resulting plans.

The workflow in @fig-human-ai connects human scientific intent to implementation,
verification, scientific assessment and reporting. Appendix B explains its six
phases and four complementary verification levels.

![Human-supervised research workflow.](figures/human_ai_workflow.png){#fig-human-ai fig-pos="H"}

The return arrows represent revision when a discrepancy is found. For example,
shared investment and probability-weighted recourse were checked in analytical
examples before large experiments. Original-unit residuals and objective
reconstruction then supported assessment of the returned decisions. Each result
was associated with its source, inputs, solver configuration and validation
record. Human scientific judgment connected this evidence to conclusions about
computational requirements and agricultural planning.
